# Legal eDiscovery Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes a document-hold workflow without giving legal
advice or claiming discovery adequacy.

## Hold Intake

The record captures matter reference, custodian group, preservation scope, and
review status as source-backed statements.

## Production Review

The workflow separates collection, deduplication, privilege review, and export
decision so each step can be traced to a responsible reviewer.

## Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim legal sufficiency, privilege correctness, or court
acceptance. It only exercises portable corpus artifact generation with
license-safe text.
